is: Twenty-two workspace crates arranged as a hexagon: an I/O-free core of domain crates (kernel, identity, workflow and the gallery and moderation stubs) behind the domain façade, one application layer of use cases, one HTTP-free composition root, two driving adapters (api, cli) over it, two HTTP crates that api and test-support share (http-cookies, http-stack), three data-boundary adapters implementing its ports, one key-custody adapter (adapter-hkdf, the dev custodian; not a fourth data boundary), a leaf config crate, three support/codegen crates, one proc-macro crate serving the application layer, and one host-agnostic engine (atta) that knows no Zurfur type.
conventions: read/write split per aggregate — `*Store` is pool-backed and non-transactional, `*Writes` is reachable only on an open `UnitOfWork`.
Closed-vocabulary enums implement std `Display`/`FromStr`, never bespoke `as_str`/`parse` pairs; id newtypes may derive serde, loaded entities never do.
Codegen crates are libraries first so the runner binary and the staleness-gate test share one generation body.
`test-support` dev-depends on `adapter-pg` while adapters dev-depend on `test-support` — a cargo dev-cycle, not a runtime edge.
`application` depends only on `domain` + `shared` + `atta` + the compile-time `application-macros` crate, never an adapter or `composition`.
entry_points: each crate's src/lib.rs — the module-level docs are the real map

fs.name: adapter-atproto/
fs.role: public boundary: OAuth sign-in, PDS records/blobs, public profile reads, did:plc minting + key custody

fs.name: adapter-hkdf/
fs.role: key-custody adapter, not a data boundary: the dev KeyCustodian — HKDF-derived keys per purpose, the v1 envelope (XChaCha20-Poly1305), the Den MAC, and the golden file with its independent script

fs.name: adapter-mem/
fs.role: in-process fakes of every port, transactional rollback included

fs.name: adapter-pg/
fs.role: private boundary: Postgres port impls, migrations, per-statement SQL files, generated typed accessors

fs.name: api/
fs.role: HTTP driver: axum router, RFC 9457 problem shape, generated wire contract, background sweeper

fs.name: application-macros/
fs.role: proc-macro crate: `#[use_case]` (injection + the unit-of-work bracket) and `#[derive(WithPorts)]`, consumed by application

fs.name: application/
fs.role: use cases — one `#[use_case]` method per use case on a per-entity namespace, called by every driver; transaction() stays for the actor-less sweep and test seeding

fs.name: atta/
fs.role: Atta, the host-agnostic engine for the Den — resolves the tree, enforces its structure, routes operations to type handlers, renders; no workspace deps

fs.name: cli/
fs.role: the zurfur terminal driver: clap subcommands over the same application use cases, in-process via Runtime

fs.name: composition/
fs.role: HTTP-free composition root shared by api + cli — loads Config, wires the live Runtime port bag

fs.name: contract-gen/
fs.role: protox+prost+pbjson generator (lib + `just gen-contract` bin) → api/src/generated

fs.name: domain/
fs.role: the domain façade: re-exports kernel, identity and workflow so every `domain::…` path resolves, and owns the unit of work

fs.name: gallery/
fs.role: gallery domain stub: a documented crate with no types, no dependencies and no dependents yet

fs.name: http-cookies/
fs.role: every cookie the HTTP driver sets (ZurfurCookie) and the session layer; consumed by api and test-support

fs.name: http-stack/
fs.role: the one HTTP stack every mount serves through: the detach layer around the session layer, and the server with its graceful shutdown; consumed by api and test-support

fs.name: identity/
fs.role: identity domain crate: who acts — users, accounts, actor identities, handles, keys, profiles, public records, bug reports — and their ports; depends on kernel

fs.name: kernel/
fs.role: bottom domain crate: the shared vocabulary (did, text, name, level, node, maturity, blob, markdown), the clock, the string-validation builder and the node port; no workspace deps

fs.name: moderation/
fs.role: moderation domain stub: a documented crate with no types, no dependencies and no dependents yet

fs.name: query-codegen/
fs.role: sqlx-rust-codegen runner (`just gen-queries`): boots a container, migrates, rewrites both adapters' src/queries.rs

fs.name: shared/
fs.role: bottom leaf crate of build-time constants that even domain may consume; no intra-workspace deps

fs.name: test-support/
fs.role: shared test rig: throwaway PDS + stub PLC, one-container/template-clone Postgres, PublicRecords conformance suite

fs.name: workflow/
fs.role: workflow domain crate: the commission aggregate and an account's boards, and their ports; depends on kernel and identity
